{"diagnosis":"Batch 13 delivered txn_ts as epoch milliseconds in a string (e.g. '1768629617000') instead of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', so the TIMESTAMP cast failed. The value converts to 2026-01-17 06:00:17 UTC, which matches the 06:00 start of each batch's day (batch 12 starts 2026-01-16 06:00). Parsing both formats in silver_transactions is therefore safe.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       ts AS txn_ts,
       CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN regexp_matches(trim(txn_ts), '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(trim(txn_ts) AS BIGINT))
              ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts
  FROM raw_transactions
  WHERE status = 'POSTED'
) s;"}}
